ui.tz_milestone_guide: Yanki da juyawa (UTC{tz_str}): Maɓallin zamewa yana daidaita lokaci; motsa UTC na iya sanya ɗan kasuwa zuwa ranar da ta gabata ko mai zuwa.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Na'urar Lokaci: Matsar da kwanaki baya ko gaba don bincika bayanan da suka wuce ko na gaba, kwatanta tarihi, da gwada yanayi. Dubawa kawai; ba a taɓa asalin bayanai ba.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 tuskin VN: ya fi son bayanan gaske, yana bincika kwararar mataki & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + rawar jiki a fadin k, p; idan akwai gibɓa 16 / 116 / 132 ko zagaye 1072 yana amfani da k*116 + p*16 a fadin k, p don daidaita mataki, yana cika gibɓa gaba idan sun bace.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Asali yana amfani da bugun 119 (k*119 + rawar jiki); idan gibɓa ta zama 16 / 116 / 132 ko ta bugi zagaye 1072 (tsarin mataki 14), yana amfani da k*116 + p*16 a fadin k, p don komawa cikin Mataki mai dacewa A (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Yana kunnuwa tare da bugun 119 (k*119 + rawar jiki); akan gibɓa 16 / 116 / 132 ko zagaye 1072 (k*116 + p*16 a fadin k, p), yana son mataki da aka daidaita A2 / C7 kuma yana komawa baya idan bayanai sun bace.
